note: The Patriots host the Packers at Gillette Stadium today, and a rain-mixed grid lines up for the Brazilian Grand Prix this afternoon.

front.title: Christopher Nolan says the DGA is holding studios to account on AI, after anti-AI language in The Odyssey
front.tldr: Christopher Nolan, now DGA president, says he is pushing studios to protect copyrighted work from AI, and included anti-AI boilerplate in contracts for The Odyssey.

front.title: Rian Johnson's new Chromagraph camera app reimagines iPhone photography
front.tldr: Director Rian Johnson has released Chromagraph, a new iPhone camera app that rethinks how smartphone photos should look, rather than chasing realism.

front.title: Rob Gronkowski's Patriots Hall of Fame induction featured jokes and an appearance from Tom Brady
front.tldr: Gronkowski was inducted into the Patriots Hall of Fame, with Tom Brady appearing and Matt Light gifting him a T-shirt reading "Yo soy Hall of Famer."

stories.title: Parents want safer phones for kids. These companies are answering the call.
stories.tldr: A growing number of companies are building phones designed for children, from feature-limited mobile devices to minimalist home phones, as parents look beyond unrestricted smartphones.

stories.title: Amazon's redesigned basic Kindle skips extras for a lighter build and better screen
stories.tldr: Amazon's redesigned basic Kindle costs more than before, but a lighter build and improved display make it a strong case against the pricier models.

stories.title: Claude Personal Finance vs. ChatGPT Finances: what sets them apart
stories.tldr: Both Claude and ChatGPT now offer to dig deep into your bank accounts, but the two tools differ in how they handle privacy settings.

stories.title: 'Backglow' lets you customise the new MacBook Pro's glowing Apple logo
stories.tldr: A new free app called Backglow, built by designer Juan Buis, lets owners of the new MacBook Pro customise the colour of its illuminated Apple logo.

stories.title: Indie App Spotlight: 'CueFlip' automatically turns the page for your sheet music
stories.tldr: CueFlip is a new indie iPhone app that automatically turns the page for musicians reading sheet music, freeing up their hands while they play.

stories.title: Mac admins are shipping AI-written code with mistakes, and fixing them is taking days
stories.tldr: A new report finds Mac admins are increasingly shipping AI-generated code that contains mistakes, and that undoing those errors is now taking days rather than minutes.

stories.title: Camerimage founder Marek Zydowicz on AI, Aronofsky and why cinematographers are artists, not technicians
stories.tldr: As Camerimage turns 34, festival founder Marek Zydowicz explains how it embraces new technology while drawing a line at fully AI-generated films, insisting cinematographers are artists, not technicians.

stories.title: AI could make filmmaking costlier than the 35mm era, Korean pioneers warn
stories.tldr: AI is cutting the cost of commercials, but a Korean AI production pioneer warns that runaway token fees and endless revisions could leave feature producers paying more than in the 35mm era.

stories.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' heads for a historic $32M box office opening
stories.tldr: Godzilla Minus Zero, the sequel to 2023's Godzilla Minus One, is on course for a historic $32 million opening weekend, with Cat in the Hat debuting at number two.

stories.title: Papua New Guinea's most expensive film, 'Mussau: The First Song,' wraps shoot
stories.tldr: Mussau: The First Song, Papua New Guinea's most expensive film at $4.5 million, has wrapped its 40-day shoot across two provinces for a historical drama.

stories.title: Celtics' beatdown of Hornets all but guarantees that they'll advance in the NBA Cup
stories.tldr: Boston's blowout win over Charlotte has all but secured their advance in the NBA Cup, after taking an early lead and never letting the Hornets back into the game.

stories.title: Former Celtic Kristaps Porzingis 'stepping away' from basketball amid health issues
stories.tldr: Kristaps Porzingis is stepping away from basketball because of ongoing health issues, having battled POTS since the end of his Celtics tenure in 2024.

stories.title: Patriots activate WR Mack Hollins to the 53-man roster
stories.tldr: The Patriots have activated wide receiver Mack Hollins from injured reserve to the 53-man roster, in time for Sunday's game against the Packers at Gillette Stadium.

stories.title: On Sunday at Gillette Stadium, Tom Brady will arrive at the top of his broadcasting game
stories.tldr: Tom Brady returns to Gillette Stadium on Sunday for Fox's broadcast, where he has become excellent company after working out what his strength as an analyst really is.

stories.title: Norris on Brazilian GP pole as Russell rages at Mercedes over aborted lap
stories.tldr: Lando Norris took a stunning pole position for the Brazilian Grand Prix at a rain-soaked Interlagos, while George Russell felt Mercedes had cost him a shot at pole.

stories.title: Hamilton insists Ferrari tensions with Leclerc are over: 'We've squashed it'
stories.tldr: Lewis Hamilton says he and Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc have cleared the air over their Mexico City clash after talks in Brazil, calling the tension squashed.

stories.title: What to watch for in the Sao Paulo Grand Prix at Interlagos
stories.tldr: Chris Medland previews five things to watch when the lights go out for today's Sao Paulo Grand Prix at the Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace.

read.subtitle: Johnny Ho, co-founder and head of product, explains how he organizes his teams like slime mold, uses AI to build their AI company, and much more

finally.title: Taller Alberto Calleja nestles concrete Casa Nova into a tree-filled site on Mexico's coast
finally.tldr: Mexican studio Taller Alberto Calleja has built Casa Nova around a tree-filled "fissure" on the country's southern coast, bridged by elevated timber walkways.
